query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_email TEXT,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_id TEXT,
  metadata JSONB,
  ip_address TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_merchant_idx ON audit_events (merchant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_actor_idx ON audit_events (actor_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_action_idx ON audit_events (action);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_created_idx ON audit_events (created_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchase_orders (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  inventory_item_id TEXT,
  item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  vendor_name TEXT,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unit',
  unit_cost_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_cost_kobo BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS po_merchant_idx ON purchase_orders (merchant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS po_status_idx ON purchase_orders (status);
